American Sign Language (ASL) Dataset
	

Description:This dataset contains 108,618 videos representing 2,208 ASL words, with each word having a minimum of 30 videos. The videos were scraped, collected from multiple sources, and preprocessed to ensure consistency, quality, and usability for machine learning and gesture recognition tasks.
